title: Knowzilla Integration | Attio
description: Navigation for sales. Real-time AI that guides every deal
tagline: Navigation for sales. Real-time AI that guides every deal

segments.t: Knowzilla is expanding its enterprise capabilities to address critical gaps in the modern sales workflow. Currently, sales reps have to manually copy AI-generated meeting notes into their CRM, and our AI assistant starts every call with a "blank slate" regarding the account's history.

The Knowzilla integration for Attio solves the "amnesiac AI" problem by bridging the gap between your live sales conversations and your CRM records. By seamlessly pushing structured intelligence (summaries, pain points, goals, and blockers) directly into Attio, this integration eliminates manual data entry and ensures your team, and your AI, always have the most up-to-date context on every deal.
The Knowzilla and Attio integration operates in a sophisticated, two-phased approach to keep your data perfectly synchronized:
Phase 1: Intelligent CRM Push & object upserting
Immediately after a live call, Knowzilla processes the AI-generated meeting assets via a resilient background queue (so reps can safely close their tabs immediately without losing data).
Smart Record Resolution:

Knowzilla doesn't just dump a note. It securely searches your Attio workspace to find the matching company (by domain/name) and person (by email). If they don't exist, Knowzilla automatically creates them.
Deal & Pipeline Awareness:
If the session is linked to a deal, Knowzilla will locate the existing deal or automatically create a new one, intelligently placing it in your workspace's active pipeline stage.
Cascading Notes:

The full structured meeting intelligence (Summary, Pain Points, Goals, Blockers) is published as a formatted Attio note. Knowzilla attaches this note to the best available record, prioritizing deals, then people, then companies.
Phase 2: "Deal Rooms" & Persistent Memory
Knowzilla utilizes "Deal Rooms" that act as a persistent intelligence layer between your calls and Attio.
The Pre-Call Briefing:
Before a meeting, Knowzilla performs a real-time fetch to pull live CRM data from Attio (including deal stage, amount, and recent notes), instantly briefing the sales rep and the AI assistant.
The Post-Call Sync:
After a call, Knowzilla updates the deal room with polished, extracted intelligence. The user can review this data before it securely syncs back to Attio.

We designed this integration to be foolproof so your team can get started in seconds. To drive high adoption, Knowzilla relies entirely on Intelligent Defaults, there is no complex custom field-mapping UI to configure.
To connect Attio:
Navigate to your Knowzilla Admin Integrations Hub.
Locate and click on the Attio connection card.
You will be securely redirected to Attio to authorize the connection.

Once authorized, Knowzilla will handle the rest. Our system automatically queries your Attio workspace to map out your custom objects (people, companies, deals) and dynamically adapts to your specific pipeline stages behind the scenes. Just connect, and your AI meeting notes will start routing perfectly.

segments.t: SolarDialer is an AI phone agent that calls your Attio people for you. Within minutes of a person joining a list you pick (or being added to your workspace), the agent calls them, reminds them what they asked about, answers their questions, and puts interested people through to your closer live, or books a callback for the time they ask.

Every call comes back to Attio: a note on the person with the outcome, an AI summary, the transcript and links to the recording; interested and transferred people added to the lists you pick; callbacks as tasks assigned to the Attio member who connected. It works for any business that follows up its leads by phone.

People in: in SolarDialer you add rules, each an Attio list (or "Any new person") and the SolarDialer campaign those people join. SolarDialer subscribes to webhooks for those events, then reads the person's name, phone numbers, email addresses and address to place the call. Someone already linked is never added twice.

People records SolarDialer creates: every call result is written to a person in Attio. When a SolarDialer lead is not linked to an Attio person yet (for example a lead uploaded to SolarDialer rather than taken from Attio), SolarDialer first looks for an existing person: by phone number (the same digits), then by email address, and uses the newest match. Only when nothing matches does it create a new person, setting just three attributes: name (first and last), phone number and email address, whichever the lead has. It never changes the attributes of existing people, never deletes records, and never creates attributes or changes your workspace's structure.

Results out: for each call that reaches someone, SolarDialer adds a note to the person titled "SolarDialer call: " with the summary, transcript and links to the recording and the call. Interested people are added to your interested list and transferred ones to your transferred list; a callback becomes a task due at the time the person asked, assigned to the Attio member who connected; a person who asks not to be called gets a note saying so and is never called again.
SolarDialer only calls within each area's legal calling hours and honours your do-not-call list.
You need a SolarDialer account (sign up free at https://solardialer.net/signup?utm_source=attio) and admin access to the Attio workspace you connect.

Under "Attio: ", pick the list for interested people and, optionally, one for transferred people, and click Save.
Add a rule: an Attio list (or "Any new person") and the SolarDialer campaign those people join.
Calls are billed per minute in SolarDialer; the Attio connection itself is free. To disconnect, click Disconnect Attio: the token is revoked and the webhook removed. Questions: info@solardialer.net.

Setup.
Connect your HeyReach API key and choose which events to listen for.
Auto-configuration.

When you install the application and add your API key, webhooks are automatically created in HeyReach to subscribe to the events you choose to listen for. These webhooks live in your HeyReach account, not in Attio.
Push to HeyReach.
Use record actions to add people to HeyReach campaigns or lists. People can be added individually, or with bulk actions. Large selections are processed in batches so they complete reliably.
Push to Attio.

Existing HeyReach leads automatically sync to Attio when they meet the criteria of the events you choose to listen for. Any new person records are automatically created. Leads are matched on email address and then LinkedIn URL, so activity is attached to people already in your workspace rather than duplicated.
Automate with HeyReach steps.
Four HeyReach steps are available in workflows:
Find HeyReach sender account - look up a LinkedIn sender account by its email address, then branch on whether it was found.
Add to HeyReach campaign - add a person to a campaign from a chosen sender account.
Add to HeyReach list - add a person to a HeyReach list.
Add to HeyReach blacklist - exclude a LinkedIn profile, email address, LinkedIn company or company name from all HeyReach campaigns, for example when a deal is won.
Choose where events are logged.
In the app's settings, set up either or both:
On the activity timeline: each event is logged as an activity on the person's timeline.
In the HeyReach Events list: one entry per event in a list of person records.
Each is created when you click its setup button, then can be switched on or off. Neither is removed if the application is uninstalled.
Conversation notes.

When a lead replies, the app writes a single markdown note on that person titled "HeyReach LinkedIn conversation with ", containing both sides of the thread. It is refreshed as the conversation continues, and the app tracks the note it created so it only ever replaces its own.

segments.t: TimelinesAI is a shared WhatsApp inbox for teams, it connects your business WhatsApp numbers so your whole team can message customers from one place. Outbound messages are sent on a one-to-one, contact-initiated basis by adding a person to a list, or with the in-record Send WhatsApp action. TimelinesAI is an independent product and is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. "WhatsApp" is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

Inbound, WhatsApp becomes a note. When someone messages one of your connected WhatsApp numbers, the app finds the matching person by phone number, creating one if there is no match, and adds a note with the message. Duplicate deliveries are ignored and an existing person is reused, so you never get duplicate people or notes.

Outbound, from a list or in-record. Send by adding a person to the "Send WhatsApp" list, or click the in-record Send WhatsApp action and reply from a composer right on the record. The message goes through TimelinesAI from your connected number and is recorded as a note.

Keeping records tidy. When two people are merged, the app re-parents its WhatsApp notes onto the surviving record so conversation history is never lost. A daily health check confirms the connection is still authorized.
Connect TimelinesAI: in TimelinesAI, make sure the WhatsApp numbers you want to mirror are connected and your team has access.

Use it: inbound messages start appearing as notes on the matching person immediately. To send, add a person to the "Send WhatsApp" list, or use the in-record Send WhatsApp action. You can disconnect at any time from the app's settings page, which removes the webhook and the data the app created.

title: Bird Integration | Attio
description: Message your customers across channels from Attio
tagline: Message your customers across channels from Attio

segments.t: Bird brings customer messaging into Attio. Send SMS, WhatsApp and email from a person record, or reach the people associated with a company, deal or lead. Select multiple people to compose an SMS or email once and send it to each recipient.

Add a person, or a whole selection of people, to a Bird audience from their record, or as a step in a workflow. Bird matches or creates the contact from the person's email address and phone number, and sets the contact's name from the person's when it creates one, so nobody handles a Bird contact ID.
Use Bird in Attio Workflows to automate SMS, WhatsApp and email sends. Start workflows when messages arrive, delivery succeeds or fails, or recipients open or click an email.

Add the Bird conversation widget to your records to read recent messages alongside your CRM data, including messages sent through other Bird tools. Open a message to compose a response. With a conversation mailbox configured, you can also read received email and reply in its thread.

Connect your Attio workspace to a Bird workspace. For record actions, the app reads a person's name, phone number and email address from Attio to prepare the recipient. On company, deal and lead records, it resolves the linked people. A record's own email address can be used when no linked person has one. Messages are sent through your connected Bird workspace.

Choose Compose SMS, Compose WhatsApp or Compose email from a record's actions. SMS and email also have bulk actions on a selection of people. The WhatsApp dialog offers approved templates and allows a text reply when the customer service window is open. In Attio Workflows, add a Bird send step and supply the recipient details and message content from your workflow.

Choose Add to Bird audience from a person's actions, or Add selected to Bird audience on a selection, and pick the audience. Bird matches an existing contact on the person's email address or phone number, and creates one from that address, phone number and name when none matches. It stores the contact it linked on the person in two attributes it creates the first time you use the action, bird_contact_id and bird_workspace_id, so a later email change still finds the same contact. Nothing else is written to your records, and clearing both attributes unlinks the person.

Use the SMS events, WhatsApp events and Email events triggers to respond to messaging activity automatically. Choose the events that start your workflow, then use each event's branch and available variables to configure the next steps.

The Bird conversation widget matches the record's resolved phone number and email address to recent Bird messages. It shows message text where available, plus channel, direction, status, time and email subject. SMS and WhatsApp include inbound and outbound messages. Email includes sent messages and, when you configure a conversation mailbox, matching messages from that mailbox. Open a row to compose a response or reply to a received email in its thread. Conversation rows, including message text, are cached in Attio app storage for up to 60 seconds; message bodies are not written to record attributes.

A workflow trigger makes an event's fields available to the steps that follow. Received SMS and WhatsApp events include message text and the counterparty's phone number. Your workflow determines whether those fields are stored in Attio records.
You need a Bird account with a workspace configured for the channels you want to use, and an Attio workspace admin to connect the app.
Install Bird in Attio and connect your Bird account through the app's workspace connection. Select the Bird workspace your team will use.
Open the app's settings and enter your default senders for the channels you use. These must be senders configured for use in Bird. Use Test connection to check the connection.
Leave the phone and email attribute settings empty to use Attio's standard attributes, or enter the custom attribute slugs used by your workspace.
Add the Bird conversation widget to the people record page through Configure page > Add Widget.
To show received email and reply in its thread, set Conversation mailbox to the Bird mailbox ID your team uses. Record viewers can read matching messages from that mailbox through the widget.
In Attio Workflows, add Bird send steps or choose an SMS events, WhatsApp events or Email events trigger and select the events you want to act on.
Members can use Edit my senders to set their own sender defaults. Admins can also configure senders for other members.

The app keeps your default senders and each member's senders in Attio's storage for as long as it is installed, and briefly caches the widget's activity rows and the audience list it offers. Each activated trigger registers one webhook endpoint in your Bird workspace and releases it when you turn the trigger off.

blocks.text: Add an alert to a workflow

segments.t: Set
Recipient
to a workspace member, write a
Subject
, and add your
Message
. Use values from earlier steps to include names, deal details, and a record URL. Messages are plain text with line breaks preserved.
The step finishes with
Queued
once Neon Deer accepts the alert, so your workflow continues without waiting for delivery. Retries of the same step execution do not create another alert.

Alerts come from alerts@notify.neondeerdata.com. If you have strict email security protocols in place, add this address to allowed senders or contacts, or ask your email administrator to allow it. Your workspace's optional prefix is added before the subject. If an admin sets a BCC address, it receives a copy of every alert, including the message.

Neon Deer checks that the recipient is an active Attio workspace member when sending. Removed or suspended members do not receive alerts. If the member list cannot be checked, the alert waits until it can be.
An admin can search and filter alerts in the Neon Deer platform, see why an alert was not sent, and open its workflow run in Attio.
Install Email Notifications in Attio.
Connect it to Neon Deer when prompted.
A workspace admin turns on
Send email alerts
under Email Notifications → Settings in the Neon Deer platform.
Add
Send email notification
to a workflow.
Only workspace admins can open Email Notifications in the Neon Deer platform. Alerts are off until an admin turns them on.
All three fields are required:
Recipient:
choose an Attio workspace member or use a member from an earlier step. Arbitrary email addresses cannot be used.
Subject:
up to 100 characters. The workspace prefix is added automatically. Any subject lines longer than the prefix length + 100 characters will be cut off, but will not fail.
Message:

up to 2,000 characters. Write several lines and insert values from earlier steps. Formatting and attachments are not supported. Any messages longer than 2,000 characters will be cut off at that limit.
Neon Deer has
Overview
Activity
, and
Settings
tabs. Overview shows recent activity, 30-day sent and not-sent totals, and alerts waiting now. Activity has search and filters for workflow, recipient, status, and creation date. Use
Stop all alerts
to turn off sending and cancel every alert still waiting.
In Settings, review the connection, choose a subject prefix of up to 40 characters, and add one optional
BCC address
. It copies every alert across all workflows; one alert with its BCC copy counts once toward the limits. An example email shows your settings without sending a message.
Delivery controls appear in this order:
Per recipient, per minute:
1, 2, or 5 alerts (default 5). More alerts to that person wait for the next minute.
Per recipient, per hour:
1, 5, 10, 25, or 50. More alerts to that person are refused; alerts already waiting count.
Per workspace, per hour:
5, 10, 25, or 50. More alerts wait until they can be sent.
Keep unsent alerts for:
15 minutes, 30 minutes, or 1 hour. Alerts still waiting after that time expire and are never sent.

segments.t: Attio logs your emails and meetings automatically, but the conversations you have with customers in Slack Connect channels never reach it.

Recordkite brings those conversations into Attio. Add it to the Slack Connect channels you share with customers, choose the Attio company for each one, and every new conversation is logged to the right company, people and deals.
One entry per conversation, not per message. Threads are logged on their own, and other messages are grouped by topic.
A summary note on the company for every conversation, with who took part and a link back to Slack.
A Slack conversation activity on the Activity tab of the company, people and deals (Attio Pro and Enterprise only).
A Last Slack interaction attribute on companies, people and deals, so you can sort, filter and build views on it.
People matched automatically by email, with a short list to review for anyone it can't match.
Recordkite only reads the Slack Connect channels you add it to and map. It never reads direct messages or your internal channels.
Connect Attio. Recordkite connects once for your whole workspace and adds a Slack conversation activity type and a Last Slack interaction attribute to companies, people and deals.
Connect Slack. We set this up with you on a short onboarding call.
Add Recordkite to a Slack Connect channel by typing /invite @Recordkite.
Map the channel to an Attio company. Recordkite suggests one from the email domains of the people in the channel, and you can add the company's deals too.
From then on, Recordkite logs every new conversation in that channel to Attio.

A thread is one conversation, and later replies update it. Messages outside threads are grouped by topic with AI, and a conversation closes after 72 hours of quiet. While a conversation is active, Recordkite updates Attio every 15 minutes. Conversations among your own team, with nobody from the customer’s side, aren’t logged. Files stay in Slack: Recordkite links to them but never copies them into Attio.

For each conversation, a summary note on the company with the AI summary, next steps, who took part and a link back to Slack. For users on Attio Pro and Enterprise plans, a Slack conversation activity on the company, the people who took part and any mapped deals, showing direction (inbound or outbound), message count and a one-line summary. And the Last Slack interaction date on the company, people and deals.

Recordkite matches people in Slack to Attio people by email, and your own team to your Attio workspace members. Anyone it can't match appears in the Recordkite dashboard, where you can link them to an existing person, create a new person under the company, or ignore them.
The companies, people and deals it needs to match conversations, and your workspace members so it can recognise your team. It doesn't copy old messages: logging starts when you map a channel.

An Attio workspace on any plan. Summary notes and Last Slack interaction work on every plan. The Slack conversation activity on the Activity tab needs Attio Pro or Enterprise; if you upgrade later, click Reconnect Attio in Recordkite's Settings to add it.
A Slack workspace where you talk to customers in Slack Connect channels. If your workspace requires admins to approve apps, a Slack admin will need to approve Recordkite.
A Recordkite plan. Pricing is per Attio workspace, by the number of channels you map, from $79 a month, with no charge per person. We set up your plan on the onboarding call.
Click Install. Sign up with your work email, create your organisation and connect your Attio workspace.
On the Get started page, book your onboarding call. On the call we connect Slack with you, answer any questions from your Slack admins, set up your plan and map your first channel together.
Add Recordkite to more Slack Connect channels with /invite @Recordkite and map each one on the Channels page in the dashboard.
In Attio, add Last Slack interaction to the Highlights on companies, people and deals so it shows at the top of each record's Overview.

segments.t: Hazelchat is an AI chat agent for your website. It answers visitors from your own pages and the sources you approve, shows where each answer came from, and says so when it doesn't know. When a visitor wants to hear from you, Hazelchat takes their enquiry.

With the Hazelchat app, every new enquiry from your website chat goes straight to Attio. Hazelchat finds the visitor in your people by email address, or adds them, and attaches a note with what they asked and where they came from. You reply with the whole conversation in view, without copying anything over from an inbox.

For each new enquiry, Hazelchat looks for a person with the visitor's email address. If there is one, it is used as it is: Hazelchat never changes a person who is already in your workspace. If there isn't, Hazelchat adds a person with the visitor's name and email address, and Attio links the company from the email domain, as it does for any new person.

It holds the visitor's message, the last question they asked and whether Hazelchat could answer it, where the chat came from (campaign, referrer, page and website) and a link to the conversation in Hazelchat. Notes are plain text, so nothing a visitor types turns into a link.

Hazelchat only looks up people by email address and reads its own notes when it has to check a send. It doesn't touch your other records, lists, deals or tasks, and it never sends chat transcripts or phone numbers. Your own tests in Hazelchat are not sent.
Sign in to Hazelchat, or start at hazelchat.co and set up your website chat.

Daily activity notes:

The note lists that day's messages and links back to the full conversation in Productlane.
System messages, AI auto-replies, and delivery confirmations are filtered out, so the record stays readable.

title: Cevanos Integration | Attio
description: AI customer service that knows your Attio customers

segments.t: Cevanos is an AI customer-service agent that answers your customers across chat, email, WhatsApp and voice, and acts on their behalf inside the systems you already run. Connecting Attio lets the agent recognise who it is talking to: it finds the customer's person record by their email address before it answers, so it can use what your team already knows instead of asking them to repeat themselves. It can also create the customer's record when one does not exist yet, keep their details current, and log a note of the conversation on their record so your team sees what happened.

An Attio admin connects the workspace once from the Integrations page in the Cevanos console and approves access on Attio's consent screen. Nothing is switched on by connecting: you then choose which Attio actions the workspace allows and which each agent uses.

When a customer is identified in a conversation, Cevanos looks up the Attio person record whose email address matches theirs. It then reads the company record linked to that person, so the agent knows which company the customer belongs to. To read these records it also reads your workspace's object configuration.

Depending on the actions you turn on and the approval rules you set, the agent can create the person record if the customer is not in Attio yet, correct that person's name or phone number (never their email address), and add a note summarising the conversation to that person's record.

Cevanos reads only the matched customer's person record and the company record linked to it, and it writes only to that person record and its notes. It does not read or change lists, tasks, deals, comments, files, or any other people or companies. Every read and write is listed in the Attio integration's activity in Cevanos. Disconnecting Attio in the Cevanos console, or uninstalling the app in Attio, stops all access.

You need a Cevanos workspace and an Attio user who can approve app access for your Attio workspace. In the Cevanos console, open Integrations, choose Attio and click Connect; you will be sent to Attio to approve access and then returned to Cevanos. No API keys or settings need to be copied. The agent only uses Attio for customers it has identified by email, and any write it makes follows the approval rules you set in Cevanos. To stop the integration, disconnect Attio in the Cevanos console or uninstall the app from your Attio workspace.

segments.t: Octolens
is the AI-powered social listening platform, used by Vercel, PostHog, Supabase, and 1000+ other teams.
It monitors all relevant platforms for B2B conversations, including
Reddit
X/Twitter
, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Bluesky, Hacker News, GitHub, news, podcasts, and more.
Every mention is scored by AI for relevance, sentiment and buying intent, so you act on signal instead of noise.

This app brings social signals into Attio's workflows. Start an automation the moment a relevant mention appears, or pull a person's mentions on demand, then create records, enrich contacts, add timeline notes, notify your team, or anything else you can build in Attio. You decide how the data maps to your CRM, Octolens supplies the signal.
Sales
: Close deals faster with more context from social posts
Customer Success
: Get early signals from signals to identify and mitigate churn risk
Marketing
: Build winning marketing campaigns by analyzing how prospects talk about your brand, your competitors, or your industry
Growth
: Generate new contacts from social posts (e.g. somebody asking for "alternative to competitor X")
The app adds workflow blocks you compose yourself:
Trigger
New Octolens mention
- choose an Octolens view; the workflow runs every time a new mention lands in it. The mention's source, author, body, link, sentiment, keyword and tags are available to downstream steps.
Step: Get mentions by author
- fetch a person's recent mentions by X handle and/or LinkedIn profile URL, map these straight from an Attio Person's attributes.
Step: Get mentions
- query your mentions by keyword, tag, source, sentiment, language, relevance, follower count or date range.
From there, use Attio's native actions to create or find records, add notes to a contact's timeline, send Slack or email, or branch on sentiment and intent tags.
Two common patterns:
enrich an existing contact or organization
when a mention's author matches a Person
create a new lead
from high-intent mentions. The documentation includes templates examples.
An Octolens account (any plan).
Admin access to your Attio workspace to install the app.
In Octolens, go to Settings →
API keys
and create a key with Read + Write scope.
Read
lets the app fetch your mentions;
Write
lets the "New Octolens mention" trigger attach a webhook to the view you choose. Octolens never holds an Attio token and makes no changes to your data on its own. You stay in control of every write.
In Attio, install the Octolens app and paste the key into the Octolens connection.
Add the Octolens trigger or any step to a workflow and configure it.
Tip: link people by social handle, not company name. The author step matches on X handle and LinkedIn profile URL, deterministic identifiers you can map directly from your Attio Person records.

segments.t: Octave is the context engine for go-to-market teams: it turns your positioning, personas, segments, use cases, competitors, proof points, into a living library that your reps, workflows, and AI agents all execute from.

Connecting Attio closes the loop with your CRM. Octave syncs your Attio deals, companies, and people, tracks every stage change as pipeline evidence, and feeds wins and losses back into your library, so your messaging, qualification, and coaching reflect what actually closes. With the Attio call recorder connected, meeting transcripts flow in too, and every insight links back to the deal it came from.
What you get:
• Live pipeline analytics on your Attio deals, win/loss, stage flow, deal health
• Voice-of-customer quotes and findings tied to real deals
• AI agents that qualify, enrich, and draft outreach using your CRM context
• Deal scorecards and action plans written back to Attio as notes and fields
Octave connects to Attio through a secure OAuth grant, no API keys to manage.
Octave will sync the following data from Attio:
• Deals, read on a rolling schedule to track stage changes, amounts, and outcomes
• Companies and people, read on demand to link deals to the right accounts and contacts
• Meetings and call recordings (optional), transcripts are imported as conversations for analysis
• Workspace members, read to attribute deals to their owners

After connecting, you choose exactly which fields Octave reads per object. Octave auto-classifies your deal stages onto a normalized pipeline (editable in Octave), and deals appear in your pipeline analytics within minutes.

Octave can also write back, optionally: deal scorecards and action plans as Attio notes, and Octave-managed attributes (prefixed octave_) carrying qualification and fit data. You control what gets installed.
You will need an Octave workspace on a plan that includes CRM integrations.
Before connecting:
Make sure the Deals object is active in your Attio workspace (Settings → Objects), it ships active by default.
In Octave, go to Settings → Integrations → Attio → Connect, approve the OAuth grant, and pick the fields to sync.
Review the auto-classified deal-stage mapping in the connect panel and adjust if needed.
Optional: connect the Attio Call Recorder the same way to import meeting transcripts, ingestion works automatically via secure polling, with a webhook provisioned for you when permissions allow.
Permissions requested: read access to records, meetings, call recordings, and workspace members; write access for notes, Octave-managed attributes, and webhooks.

title: Parsley Integration | Attio
description: Actionable intent signals for sales
tagline: Actionable intent signals for sales

segments.t: Parsley captures buyer intent signals from every profile interaction and syncs them directly to Attio, giving your sales team actionable intelligence before the first call.
The Problem

Sales reps spend hours researching prospects before calls, yet still walk in blind. They don't know what the prospect actually cares about until they get on the phone. Meanwhile, leads from events and outreach sit in spreadsheets, decaying before anyone follows up.
The Solution

Parsley profiles include an AI chatbot that engages prospects 24/7. When someone visits your profile, they can ask questions about your product, pricing, or how you compare to competitors. The chatbot answers from your uploaded documents, and captures their intent in the process.
Every interaction generates structured intent data:
BANT signals - Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline indicators with actual quotes
Lead quality scoring - Hot, warm, or cold based on engagement depth
Intent classification - Pricing inquiry, feature comparison, technical evaluation, or general research
Conversation summary - What they asked, what mattered most
This intelligence syncs automatically to Attio as People records with linked Notes. Your reps see exactly what prospects care about before picking up the phone.
Who It's For
Sales teams who want pre-call intelligence on every prospect
RevOps who want structured lead data flowing into their CRM automatically
Founders who want their profile working for them while they sleep
The Result
No more guessing. No more manual data entry. Every Parsley conversation becomes actionable CRM data in Attio.
Parsley syncs two types of data to Attio: Contacts and Conversation Intelligence.
Contact Sync
When someone shares their contact information through your Parsley profile, via the contact form or through the AI chatbot - they're automatically created in Attio as a Person record.
The sync includes:
Name
Email address
Phone number
Company
Job title
Parsley uses Attio's Assert API, so existing contacts are updated rather than duplicated. Email address is the matching key.
Conversation Intelligence Sync
When the AI chatbot completes a conversation, Parsley creates a Note in Attio linked to the Person record. This note contains:
Conversation summary - Key points from the exchange
Lead quality - Hot, warm, or cold rating
Intent signal - High intent, evaluation, research, or support
BANT indicators - Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline signals with supporting quotes
Engagement metrics - Message count, session duration, return visitor status
Knowledge gaps - Questions the chatbot couldn't answer (reveals unmet prospect needs)
Sync Timing
Contact sync: Immediate (triggered on form submission or chatbot lead capture)
Conversation sync: Immediate (triggered when conversation ends)
Data Flow
Prospect visits Parsley profile ↓ AI chatbot engages, captures intent ↓ Contact synced to Attio (People) ↓ Conversation summary synced (Notes) ↓ Rep sees full context before the call
Prerequisites
A Parsley account with an active profile
An Attio workspace with API access
Step 1: Connect Attio
Log in to your Parsley dashboard
Navigate to Hub → Integrations
Find the Attio card and click Connect
You'll be redirected to Attio to authorize the connection
Grant the requested permissions (Records, Notes, Object Configuration)
You'll be redirected back to Parsley with a confirmation
Step 2: Verify Connection
Once connected, the Attio card shows:

title: Origami Integration | Attio
description: AI prospecting that dedupes against your Attio CRM
tagline: AI prospecting that dedupes against your Attio CRM

segments.t: Origami is an AI-powered prospecting platform. Describe your ideal customer in a sentence, and Origami's agent searches across 15+ live data sources (funding rounds, job changes, hiring signals, technographics, headcount changes) and returns a spreadsheet of qualified prospects you can enrich, export, or pipe into outreach.

Connecting Attio gives the agent access to your existing pipeline. Every lead it finds is checked against the people and companies in your Attio workspace, so your team stops wasting outreach on contacts you're already working. You can also point the agent at an Attio list and ask it to enrich those records with firmographic and contact data, or use a closed-won list as the seed for lookalike research.

The most common workflows are growing pipeline without polluting the CRM, bulk-enriching existing records, and finding lookalikes off your best customers. Origami reads your Attio data, it never writes back, so the CRM stays your source of truth.
Once Origami is connected to your Attio workspace, the integration shows up in three places.

Right after you connect, Origami runs a one-time discovery job that reads your Attio schema. It pulls every object, attribute, and list, then writes two reference docs: a schema map and a knowledge base describing how your team actually uses Attio. The knowledge base captures the things that aren't obvious from the schema alone, like which fields you treat as dedup keys, which custom attributes matter, and the naming conventions specific to your workspace. Both docs are editable inside Origami, and the agent reads them before every CRM-aware task.

When you ask Origami to build or enrich a lead list, every prospect is checked against your Attio people and companies before being added to the spreadsheet. Matches are flagged inline, with a link back to the matching Attio record. The default dedup logic runs on email exact match first, then LinkedIn URL, then a name plus company fallback. If your team uses different keys, change the dedup section in the knowledge base and the agent picks up the new rules on the next run.

The agent can also pull records directly from Attio. For example, "enrich every company in my Q2 Outbound list with recent funding news," or "find similar companies to the accounts in my closed-won list." Queries hit the Attio API live and support filters, foreign-key relationships up to five hops deep, and multi-value attributes. Results come back as a spreadsheet you can keep working in.
All Attio API calls run server-side using OAuth tokens with read-only scopes (record_permission:read, object_configuration:read, user_management:read). Origami never writes to your Attio workspace.
Connecting Attio takes about a minute. The integration uses OAuth, there are no API keys or webhooks to manage.
Sign up at
https://origami.chat
. The Attio integration is available on all paid plans, and new accounts can start a free trial during sign-up.
In Origami, click your workspace name in the top-left, then go to Settings → Integrations. Attio is listed in the CRM section alongside Salesforce and HubSpot.
Click Connect next to Attio. You'll be redirected to Attio's OAuth consent screen and asked to approve three read-only scopes:
record_permission:read
, to read people, companies, and other records
object_configuration:read
, to read your workspace's object and attribute schema
user_management:read
, to identify which Attio user authorized the connection
Approve the scopes and you'll land back on the Origami integrations page with the connection live.

Connecting kicks off a one-time discovery job that takes 30 to 60 seconds. When it finishes, two documents appear at Settings → Integrations → CRM context, a schema map and a knowledge base. Skim the knowledge base before your first run and adjust the dedup keys section if your team uses non-default fields, for example a custom linkedin_url attribute or a specific account_owner field. The agent reads these docs on every run, so edits take effect immediately.

blocks.text: Step 5. Run your first prospecting task

segments.t: Open a new chat in Origami and try a prompt like "Find Series B SaaS companies in fintech that aren't already in my Attio workspace." The agent searches live data sources, dedupes against Attio in real time, and returns a spreadsheet you can enrich, export, or send to your outreach tool.

You can revoke the connection at any time from Settings → Integrations in Origami, or from the Apps section of your Attio workspace settings. Disconnecting stops all Attio API calls immediately and clears the cached schema and knowledge base.

Connect Attio with Google Sheets and keep your CRM data synced without manual copy-pasting.

This integration helps your team push Attio records into Google Sheets, update data more easily, and build flexible workflows around the tools you already use every day. Whether you want to create simple reports, share live customer data with your team, or manage records in bulk, this app makes the process much faster.
What you can do
Sync Attio records with Google Sheets
Keep Google Sheets updated automatically
Update Attio data from Google Sheets
Create two-way sync workflows
Manage customer data in a spreadsheet-friendly way
Why teams use it
Attio is great for managing relationships, while Google Sheets is still one of the easiest ways to review, edit, organize, and share data. This integration gives you the best of both.
Use it to:
Build internal reports
Export and review CRM data
Bulk update records faster
Share live data with your team
Create operational workflows outside Attio
How it works
Choose the Attio records you want to sync, connect your Google Sheet, and let the app handle the rest. You can keep data flowing automatically so your sheet stays up to date as records change.
This is especially useful for teams that want more flexibility in how they view, edit, and operationalize CRM data without relying on manual exports.
Built for Attio teams
If your team works in both Attio and Google Sheets, this integration helps remove busywork and keeps your data connected across both tools.
Save time, reduce manual work, and make it easier for your team to work with Attio data where they already feel comfortable.
Set up your sync in 3 simple steps.
First, connect your Attio account and Google Sheets account. Once both accounts are linked, choose the Attio object you want to sync, such as People or Companies.
Next, select your sync direction. You can send data from Google Sheets to Attio, pull data from Attio into Google Sheets, or choose a bidirectional sync to keep both systems updated automatically.
Then, choose the Google Spreadsheet and sheet tab you want to use. After that, map your Attio fields to the correct Google Sheets columns and finalize the setup.

Once your sync is live, the app keeps data flowing between Attio and Google Sheets based on the workflow you selected. This makes it easy to manage records, keep spreadsheets updated, and reduce manual work across both tools.
The app is designed to give you full control over how your Attio and Google Sheets sync works, both during setup and after the sync is created.

When creating a new sync, you start by choosing the Attio object you want to connect, such as People, Companies, or other supported objects. Then select the sync direction that fits your workflow: Google Sheets to Attio, Attio to Google Sheets, or bidirectional sync if you want both systems to stay aligned automatically.

Next, choose the Google Spreadsheet and the specific sheet tab you want to connect. After that, configure your field mappings so Attio properties match the correct columns in Google Sheets. This lets you control exactly how data moves between both systems.

Once a sync is created, you can manage it from the syncs dashboard. Each sync gives you visibility into its current status, sync direction, and recent activity. You can search through existing syncs, manually trigger a sync, pause or resume it, edit the configuration, or delete it when no longer needed.
The dashboard also helps surface issues that need attention, such as duplicate or missing key values, so you can quickly identify problems and keep your data syncing correctly.

This makes the integration flexible not just at setup, but throughout the full lifecycle of your workflow. You can configure how data should sync, monitor how each sync is performing, and make changes whenever your process evolves.

title: Luma Events Integration | Attio
description: Delightful events start here
tagline: Delightful events start here

segments.t: Sync your Luma events directly into Attio. This app pulls event data from your Luma calendar and creates event records in your CRM, complete with details, timing, and attendee tracking. When attendees register or update their status in Luma, the app automatically creates or updates people records and links them to events through relationship fields, giving you a real-time view of who’s registered, confirmed, checked in, or declined for each event.

What it sets up: A custom “Events” object in your Attio workspace with predefined fields for event details, timing, and attendee relationships. Widgets on both event and people records give you quick visibility into attendance data.
Note: This app currently syncs events from a single Luma calendar. Support for multiple calendars is planned for a future release.

Connect Luma to Attio and bring your event data into your CRM automatically. The app creates an “Events” object with fields for event name, description, start/end times, location, URL, and visibility status.

Event sync: Use the manual “Sync Luma Events” button in workspace settings to pull all events from your Luma calendar into Attio. Once webhooks are active, new and updated events sync automatically in real time.

Attendee sync: Use the “Sync Attendees” button in workspace settings to backfill guests for every synced event. Each Luma guest becomes (or updates) a person record and is linked to the event by status. Going forward, attendee changes sync automatically in real time via webhooks.

Note: the manual “Sync Luma Events” and “Sync Attendees” buttons run in your browser and process your calendar in batches, so large calendars import without timing out. Keep the settings tab open until the run finishes; if you navigate away, the run pauses, but both syncs are idempotent (events dedupe by event ID, attendees by email), so you can safely click the button again to continue.

Attendee tracking: When guests register or update their status in Luma, the app automatically creates people records with rich profile data, including job title, registration source (UTM parameters), and opt-in preferences. Attendees are linked to events through four relationship fields: Registered Attendees, Confirmed Attendees, Checked In Attendees, and Declined Attendees. When a guest’s status changes (e.g., from registered to confirmed), they’re automatically moved to the correct field. The same vocabulary is used by other event-platform integrations like Swoogo, so attendance data unifies across sources.

Widgets: On event records, an attendee stats breakdown shows the total count plus registered / confirmed / checked in / declined. On people records, an attendance history is organized by status. Both widgets appear on the relevant records automatically.
Duplicate handling: Events are matched by Luma event ID and attendees by email address, so duplicates are handled automatically.
Get your Luma API key: Log in to your Luma account, go to Settings -> API, and generate or copy your API key.
Get your Calendar ID: Open your Luma calendar and copy the calendar ID from the URL (e.g., cal-abc123).

Connect to Attio: Install the Luma Events app in your Attio workspace. A workspace admin then opens Workspace Settings -> Connections and sets up the workspace connection, pasting the Luma API key. Setting it up as a workspace connection means the whole workspace syncs from one Luma account, so you configure it once instead of per person. The app will automatically create the Events object, configure relationship fields, and register webhooks with Luma. If teammates connected earlier with their own personal connection, that keeps working, but we recommend an admin setting up the workspace connection and removing the older personal connections so everyone shares one source of truth.
Set your Calendar ID: In the Calendar Settings section of workspace settings, enter your Luma Calendar ID.

Sync your events: Click “Sync Luma Events” to pull existing events from your Luma calendar into Attio. Going forward, new and updated events will sync automatically via webhooks. To backfill guests for those events, click “Sync Attendees”.
Configure sync options (optional) Sync Attendees: Sync event guests as people records when they register or update in Luma (enabled by default)
Sync on Webhook: Automatically sync events and attendees when changes happen in Luma (enabled by default)

title: Dedupe Integration | Attio
description: Duplicate management for Attio
tagline: Duplicate management for Attio

segments.t: Dedupe is a duplicate-management platform built specifically for Attio.

Attio’s native merge handles two records at a time and leaves you to pick a winner; Dedupe resolves the entire cluster - three, five, nine records at once assembles a surviving record attribute by attribute, and carries every note, task, file, list membership and relationship across before the duplicates are retired.

It runs in two modes: a one-time cleanup that corrects an existing mess, or continuous monitoring that catches new duplicates as forms, imports and enrichment create them. Detection is transparent (per-object, per-attribute match rules with weights and guardrails), automation is confidence-gated (auto-merge above your threshold, ambiguous clusters queued for review), and every merge is logged and reversible for 30 days. Works across Companies, People and any custom object.

Detect: Fuzzy and exact matching per object and attribute (domain, email, phone, name), with normalization for legal suffixes, punctuation, subdomains and free-mail addresses. Related records are grouped into clusters, not just pairs.

Resolve: Each cluster arrives with a smart-merge suggestion: the most complete, most recent, most-trusted value per field. Accept the row or override any cell. Save a resolution as a rule and it applies to every future cluster.

Migrate: Notes, tasks, files, list memberships, linked people/deals and activity move to the surviving record. Nothing is silently dropped, if something can’t be moved, the merge stops and tells you why.

Keep it clean: Continuous monitoring checks new and updated records on arrival. Obvious duplicates auto-merge above your confidence threshold; the rest land in a review queue with the evidence beside them.
Undo anything: Every resolution writes an audit entry. Roll back a single merge or a whole run for 30 days; retired records return exactly as they were.
Connect Attio: Authorize via Attio’s API with scoped access. Restrict Dedupe to specific objects; every write is attributed and logged.
Choose objects: Enable Companies, People and/or any custom object you want monitored.

Set match rules: Per attribute, pick a comparison (exact / fuzzy / normalized) and a weight. Mark identity-critical fields (e.g. billing country) as guardrails so franchises, subsidiaries and regional entities are never grouped.
Set thresholds: Define the auto-merge score (e.g. ≥ 0.95) and the review band (e.g. 0.80-0.95). Above auto-merges, in-band queues, below is ignored.
Run a read-only scan: Get the cluster count, affected objects and proposed resolution plan. Nothing is written until you approve.
Resolve or automate: Work the queue manually, or turn approved resolutions into saved rules and enable continuous monitoring.
Safety options: Dry-run mode previews outcomes before any write; writes are rate-limited so it’s safe against a live workspace; rollback stays available for 30 days.

title: Deduptio Integration | Attio
description: Find, review, and merge duplicate records in Attio
tagline: Find, review, and merge duplicate records in Attio

segments.t: Duplicate records creep into every CRM: the same person imported twice, a company created by two teammates, an enriched record that didn't match the original. They split your activity history, skew reports, and embarrass you in outreach.

Deduptio finds those duplicates and removes them safely. It scans the objects you choose: people, companies, or any custom object, using match rules you control, groups records that are really the same entity, and shows each group side by side with the reason it matched. You pick the record that survives, preview the result, and merge: one group at a time, or hundreds in one click.

Merges use Attio's native record merge, so emails, calls, notes, tasks, and list entries follow the surviving record. Nothing is ever written to your workspace until you approve an action, and every merge stays reversible for 24 hours. Duplicate list entries left behind by merges are cleaned up automatically, with the same 24-hour restore.
Scans are read-only, dry-run previews are free on every plan, and scheduled scans email you when new duplicates appear, so your workspace stays clean after the first big cleanup, too.
Match rules you control.
Define per object what makes two records the same: matching email addresses, domains, names, or phone numbers, exact or fuzzy, combined with ANY or ALL logic.
Read-only scans.

Run a scan on demand or on a daily/weekly schedule. Deduptio pages through the object's records, applies your rule, and creates duplicate groups, each with the reason its members matched. When a scheduled scan finds something new, you get an email.
A review queue built for judgment calls.

Each group shows its records side by side with comparable fields and a proposed keeper (typically the oldest, most complete record). Override the choice, preview the merge, merge, or skip groups that aren't real duplicates, skipped groups never come back.
Bulk merging.
Filter by object, select the groups you trust, or select all, and merge them in one run. Each group keeps the record you chose.
Native, lossless merges.
Deduptio calls Attio's own record merge, so activity history, emails, calls, notes, tasks, and list memberships are preserved on the surviving record.
Lists stay clean.

If merged records shared a list, the leftover duplicate entry is removed automatically (keep-oldest, snapshotted). Lists with older duplicate entries can be cleaned with a keep-oldest or keep-newest rule, and duplicate records sitting in the same list can be merged straight from the list view.
Everything is reversible.
Every merge and every removed list entry can be restored for 24 hours from the merge log and removal log.
Setup takes a few minutes and requires no changes inside Attio:
Create an account at deduptio.com and verify your email.

Click "Connect Attio" and approve the OAuth request for the workspace you want to clean. Deduptio reads records and lists to find duplicates; it writes only when you confirm a merge or a list cleanup.
Open Rules and create a match rule for your first object, for example, people match when their email addresses are equal. Add more keys or switch to fuzzy matching as needed.
Open Scan and run your first scan. For ongoing hygiene, enable the daily or weekly schedule; you'll be emailed when new duplicate groups appear.
Review the groups on the Duplicates page, pick the record to keep in each, and merge, individually or in bulk. The merge log keeps every merge restorable for 24 hours.

If your Attio token ever expires, Deduptio shows a Reconnect link, re-authorizing takes one click and keeps all rules, groups, and history. The Free plan includes 25 live merges per month with objects up to 10,000 records; paid plans add unlimited merges, fuzzy matching, and larger objects. Full documentation: deduptio.com/docs.

segments.t: FuseAI is an AI sales platform for outbound teams. It finds prospects in a database of 700M+ B2B contacts, enriches them with verified emails and phone numbers, and runs multi-step outreach across email, LinkedIn and phone from one place. Buying signals such as job changes, funding rounds and website visits tell reps who to contact and when.

The FuseAI app keeps your Attio workspace up to date with that work. The people and companies FuseAI finds are added as people and company records and linked to each other. Every email, LinkedIn message and call FuseAI sends is logged as a note on the person, and attributes on each person show who opened, clicked, replied or bounced. In the other direction, FuseAI pulls people and companies from Attio so your team can enrich them and keep existing customers out of new campaigns.
Add people and companies to Attio

FuseAI creates a person record for each contact it pushes, matched on email address so the same person is never added twice. The person's company is created or matched on its domain and linked to the person. Scheduled pushes only fill attributes that are empty in Attio, so edits your team has made are never overwritten. When you select specific people in FuseAI and push them, their values are refreshed. People without an email address are not pushed.
Log outreach as notes

Every campaign email, LinkedIn message, connection request and InMail that FuseAI sends is added as a note on the person's record. Calls from the FuseAI dialer are logged with their direction, outcome, duration and full transcript. Notes are written once as a permanent log, and activity syncs every hour.
Track engagement on people

The first time it runs, FuseAI adds three attributes to the people object: Fuse engagement (Opened, Clicked, Replied, Bounced), Fuse last engaged at and Fuse last campaign. They are kept current, so you can filter, sort and build lists and views of the people who are responding. FuseAI only ever writes to these three attributes.
Bring Attio records into FuseAI

FuseAI pulls people and companies from Attio on a schedule and receives a webhook whenever a record is created or updated, so changes reach FuseAI straight away. Pulled records appear in FuseAI as All Attio Contacts and All Attio Companies, where you can enrich them or exclude them from campaigns. Notes and tasks linked to people in Attio also appear on that person's timeline in FuseAI.
Control what syncs

Pushing people, pushing companies, pulling people and pulling companies each have their own switch, and all four start off. You can also turn off individual attributes FuseAI would otherwise write, such as job title or phone number. Email address, name and LinkedIn URL are always written.
Before you start
You need a FuseAI account on a paid plan and the Owner or Admin role on your FuseAI team. A FuseAI team can connect one CRM at a time.
Connect your workspace
In FuseAI, go to Settings › Integrations › CRM.
Click Connect on the Attio card.
Review the access FuseAI requests and click Confirm. You are returned to FuseAI, which registers its webhook automatically.
Choose what syncs
Click Settings on the Attio card.
On the Configuration tab, under Team sync credentials, choose whose Attio connection runs scheduled syncs, then click Save.
On the Sync tab, tick what should run automatically: Pull contacts, Pull companies, Push contacts and activity (this also sends notes and engagement), and Push companies. Click Save.
Optionally, on the Fields tab, turn off any attributes you don't want FuseAI to write.
To sync straight away, use Pull all contacts, Pull all companies, Push contacts or Push companies on the Sync tab.
Push people from a list
Select people in any FuseAI list, then choose CRM Push › Push to Attio.
Disconnect

In FuseAI, go to Settings › Integrations › CRM and click Disconnect on the Attio card. FuseAI removes its webhook and stops syncing. To remove the app completely, an Attio admin can uninstall it under Workspace settings › Apps.

title: Tapni Integration | Attio
description: Business card platform with lead capture and AI scanner
tagline: Business card platform with lead capture and AI scanner

segments.t: Tapni is a business card platform that replaces traditional business cards with NFC-powered digital profiles. When your team members scan business cards, or share their Tapni cards at events, meetings, and conferences, every new contact is captured instantly in the Tapni dashboard, complete with name, email, phone, job title, company, and custom notes.

The Attio integration brings those contacts directly into your CRM workspace as people records, eliminating manual data entry and ensuring no lead falls through the cracks. Whether your sales team is networking at a trade show or your executives are meeting prospects over coffee, every connection flows into Attio in real-time.
Key capabilities:
Automatic real-time sync:
Every new contact captured via Tapni is instantly exported to Attio as a person record. No manual steps required.
Bulk export:
Export your full Tapni contact history to Attio with a single click from the Tapni Business Dashboard.
Smart upsert:

When a contact already exists in Attio (matched by email), the integration can update the existing record instead of creating duplicates. You control whether updates apply to all matching contacts, only those originally exported by Tapni, or are disabled entirely.
Configurable field mapping:

Map any Tapni contact field, including custom profile fields, tags, and team information, to any Attio people attribute. The default mapping covers email, name, phone, job title, company, and website, but you can customize it to fit your workflow.
Export on contact update:
Optionally re-sync contacts to Attio whenever they are updated in Tapni, keeping your CRM data fresh as relationships evolve.
Full logging and visibility:
Every export is logged with success/error status, so your team always knows what synced and what needs attention.

The integration is designed for B2B teams that rely on face-to-face networking and need their CRM to reflect every interaction without friction. It works across all Tapni products including NFC cards, stickers, bands, and the Tapni mobile app.
Tapni integration connects to your Attio workspace via OAuth. Once authorized, it syncs contacts from Tapni into Attio people records using the following flow:
Connect your workspace.

Open the Tapni Business Dashboard, navigate to Integrations, and click "Connect with Attio". You will be redirected to Attio to authorize the connection. Tapni requests permission to read and write records and read workspace members. Once approved, the integration is active.
Configure sync behavior.
After connecting, choose how the integration operates: Enable auto-export to automatically push every new Tapni contact to Attio in real-time.
Enable export on update to re-sync contacts whenever they are modified in Tapni.

Set a contact update mode: "Disabled" creates new people only; "Update Tapni-created" updates records that were previously exported by Tapni; "Update all" updates any person in Attio with a matching email address.
Customize field mapping.

The Fields Mapping tab lets you control exactly which Tapni data maps to which Attio attribute. By default, email maps to email_addresses, first and last name to the name attribute, phone to phone_numbers, job title to job_title, company to company, and website to website. You can add or change mappings, including Tapni-specific fields like tags (markers) and custom profile fields.
Contacts flow into Attio.

When a team member captures a new contact through their Tapni card, whether via NFC tap, QR scan, or manual entry. The integration immediately creates or updates a person record in Attio. The contact's email is used as the matching attribute, leveraging Attio's native assert (upsert) capability to prevent duplicates.
Bulk export existing contacts.
Already have contacts in Tapni? Use the Export dropdown on the Connections page to push your full contact list to Attio in one batch. The same field mapping and update mode rules apply.
View synced contacts
. After export, each Tapni connection shows a direct link to the corresponding Attio person record, so your team can jump straight to the CRM with one click.
Workspace members from Attio are fetched during export to support owner mapping, allowing you to associate each contact with the correct team member in your CRM.
Prerequisites:
A Tapni Business account with an active workspace.
An Attio workspace where you have permission to install integrations.
Step 1: Install the integration

In the Tapni Business Dashboard, go to Integrations and click the Attio tile. Click "Connect with Attio" to begin the OAuth authorization flow. You will be redirected to Attio, where you must approve the following permissions:
Read-write on records (to create and update people)
Read on workspace members (to map contact owners)
Read on object configuration (to sync available field definitions)
After approving, you are redirected back to Tapni and the integration is connected.
Step 2: Enable automatic sync

Toggle "Auto-Export Tapni contacts into Attio" to enable real-time sync. When enabled, an automation is created that exports every new contact to Attio as soon as it is captured. Optionally, enable "Export when contact is updated" to also sync changes to existing contacts.
Step 3: Set update mode.
Choose how the integration handles contacts that already exist in Attio:
Disabled: Only create new people records. If a person with the same email already exists, the export is skipped.
Update Tapni-created only: Update people records that were originally created by a previous Tapni export. Other records are left untouched.
Update all matching contacts: Update any person in Attio whose email matches the exported contact. Use this mode when you want Tapni to be the authoritative source for contact data.
Step 4: Configure field mapping.

Navigate to the Fields Mapping tab. The integration pre-loads available Attio people attributes from your workspace. For each field, choose the Tapni source (e.g., email, first name, phone, tags, custom profile fields) and the target Attio attribute. Toggle the overwrite flag per field to control whether existing values in Attio should be replaced during updates.
Default field mapping:
Email → email_addresses
First name → name (first_name)
Last name → name (last_name)
Job title → job_title
Phone → phone_numbers
Company → company
Website → website
Tags → description

You can add additional mappings or remove defaults to match your team's workflow. Click "Sync Fields" to refresh the list of available Attio attributes if you have added custom attributes to your Attio workspace.
Step 5: Save changes
. Click "Save Changes" to apply your configuration. The integration is now active and will operate according to your settings.

Disconnecting: To disconnect the integration, navigate to the Attio integration page in Tapni and disable the sync toggles. To fully remove access, revoke the Tapni app from your Attio workspace settings at
app.attio.com

title: Subdomain Merge Integration | Attio
description: Review and merge companies with related domains
tagline: Review and merge companies with related domains

segments.t: Subdomain Merge finds company records that share a root domain or use its subdomains. An optional mode also suggests matching domain names across extensions, such as example.com and example.net.

Every candidate shows company names, full domains, populated attribute counts and the proposed primary. Cross-extension matches always warn that domain ownership may differ. Verify that all companies belong to the same organization before merging.
Choose the primary company, review the records and explicitly confirm each merge inside Attio. No merges run automatically in the background.

Open Companies and choose Scan subdomain duplicates from the object actions menu. The initial scan finds records sharing the same root domain. Select Include other extensions to also compare identical domain names across extensions, including suffixes such as.co.uk. Select Subdomains only to return to the standard scan.

Shared platforms, invalid domains and records spanning unrelated domain names are excluded. Name mismatches and primary conflicts appear as review warnings. Similar spelling alone is never used to suggest a match.
Select Change primary if needed, then Merge records. The confirmation explains which company will be primary and warns again when extensions differ. Primary values win conflicts.
After the merge, open the final company to check its preserved domains and activity. A new scan is required before another merge.
No external account, API key or configuration is required after installation.
The app needs read and write access to records so it can scan and merge company records. It also needs read access to object configuration, as required by the public merge endpoint.
Open the Companies list whenever you want to scan. No scheduled or automatic merge runs in the background.
Full usage, safety, support and privacy documentation is available at https://buildrhaus.com/apps/subdomain-merge/.

title: Shuttio Integration | Attio
description: Move HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Affinity, CSV to Attio
tagline: Move HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Affinity, CSV to Attio

segments.t: Shuttio moves the CRM you are leaving into Attio: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Affinity or a CSV file. It moves records, the links between them, notes, tasks, meetings, files attached to records, and lists. It costs $0 at any record count.
Shuttio reads your source's schema and recreates your objects, fields, select options and lists in Attio. You review every object and every field mapping before it writes anything to your workspace.

Owners and task assignees are matched to Attio workspace members by email. A deal owner in HubSpot, Pipedrive or Salesforce becomes the deal's owner in Attio. An owner whose email matches no member is skipped, and the run reports it.

Every run reports on every record. A record that fails is listed with its reason and a suggested fix, and so are the records that depend on it. Rollback deletes the records, notes, tasks, meetings and files the migration created, and archives the attributes it added. Attio's API has no endpoint to delete a list, so Shuttio names the lists it created and you remove them in Attio.

Pick the source and Attio as the destination on the From / To picker. Connect Attio, then the source: HubSpot, Pipedrive and Salesforce use their own sign-in, Affinity takes an API key, a CSV is uploaded.
Choose what to move: attachments, custom fields, pipelines, lists. Tick the objects.
Review the fields. Keep, skip or rename a field, add value rewrites or defaults, and choose the column that identifies a record. Set filters per object if you want a subset.

A migration from a CRM runs 50 records per object as a free sample first. Check them in Attio, then run everything. People match on email and companies on domain, so a re-run updates records and creates no duplicates. A CSV imports in full, with no sample.

Shuttio links records to each other in a second pass, then imports notes, tasks, meetings, files and list memberships onto the right records. Calls land in Attio's Phone calls; SMS, WhatsApp and LinkedIn messages, logged emails and other source activity types land in Attio activities.
Read the results: counts per object, every failed row with its reason, and a lookup of the source record. Roll back from the More menu at any time.
Install Shuttio from the Attio App Store, or go to shuttio.com and choose Start free.
Create a Shuttio account with Google or with an email and password.
Approve the Attio connection on Attio's consent screen.
Choose the source and connect it. HubSpot, Pipedrive and Salesforce use their own OAuth; Affinity takes an API key; a CSV needs no connection.
Follow the seven steps in the left rail: Source, Connect, Options, Objects, Fields, Filters, Import.

To disconnect, remove Shuttio from your Attio workspace's apps settings. Shuttio also deletes its stored Attio token 14 days after the migration finishes. Records already imported stay in your workspace.

Every contact captured at an event is pushed into Attio as a contact (and optionally a deal), complete with the enriched company data, the conversation context, and the follow-up notes your rep dictated on the spot. Built for sales teams that go to trade shows, conferences, and networking events, SpeakSoon gives you:

blocks.text: Networking becomes measurable pipeline in Attio.

During an event, reps send SpeakSoon whatever they have: a photo of a business card, an event badge, a LinkedIn screenshot, or a voice note about the conversation. SpeakSoon processes the input, looks up the person and company (LinkedIn profile, website, VAT number, industry, company size, and description), and stores everything as a contact with your notes and tasks attached.

Back at the dashboard, you review the captured contacts and push them to Attio in one click, individually or as a batch. SpeakSoon creates the Person and Company in Attio, carries over all notes and tasks, and optionally creates a Deal when configured.

title: Twain Integration | Attio
description: Turn Attio lists into researched, personalized outreach
tagline: Turn Attio lists into researched, personalized outreach

segments.t: Twain is a GTM agent that researches every contact in real time and writes outreach from what it finds. Connect Attio and your CRM becomes both the source of who to reach and the home for the research and copy Twain produces.

Point Twain at an Attio list of people and it imports them and researches each one: buying signals, LinkedIn and company context, and contact qualification. At deeper research levels it also writes a thesis and strategy for each prospect. It then drafts a multi-step email and LinkedIn sequence grounded in that research, not one template with merge tags swapped in.

When the campaign is ready, Twain writes the messages, subject lines and research back to each person's record in Attio and adds those people to a list you choose. Exporting again updates the same record and keeps one list entry per person instead of creating duplicates. Add the Attio import to a Twain workflow and people added to the list later are picked up automatically, so a segment your team already maintains keeps producing researched outreach.
Attio's workflow agents can also read your Twain campaigns, people and research through Twain's MCP server.
Pick an Attio list of people and Twain imports them. Twain suggests how your attributes map onto its fields, and you can change any of them:
Email → Email addresses
Name → Name
Job title → Job title
LinkedIn → LinkedIn
Company → Company
Location → Primary location
Each person needs a LinkedIn profile URL or a work email; records with neither are skipped. One import can bring in up to 25,000 people.
Twain creates or updates people records matched on email address, so exporting a campaign twice updates the same record instead of creating a duplicate. It writes:
each sequence message, one attribute per step
subject lines for each step
research: signals, absent signals, thesis, strategy, warnings, headline, other roles and company info
lead details: job title, location, company size and website
name, email and LinkedIn

You choose the attribute for each field, and Twain creates any that don't exist yet. Attributes Attio fills itself, and email or phone attributes, aren't offered. Exporting research needs a Twain plan that includes it.
Twain also adds every exported person to an Attio list of people you pick. Exporting again keeps one entry per person, so the list stays clean.

Add the Attio import to a Twain workflow and it watches the list, importing people as they are added, including anyone who leaves and is later added back. You choose whether the first run also enrolls the people already in the list or only those added from then on.

blocks.text: Use Twain from Attio's AI agents

segments.t: The Twain app connects Twain's MCP server to Attio, so a custom agent in an Attio workflow can read your Twain workspace and use what Twain has researched and written. The agent can:
list your Twain workspaces, agents, campaigns and automations
read a campaign's setup, prices and activity log, and an automation's settings
list the people in a campaign and read each one's sequence and research
check a generation's progress and your Twain credit balance
These tools only read, so an agent never changes your campaigns or spends Twain credits. On Twain's Starter plan, a person's research, thesis and strategy stay in the Twain app.
Connecting takes one authorization: open the Attio integration in Twain and approve access. If access is ever revoked, reconnect once.
Create a campaign, or open an existing one, and choose Attio as the lead source.
Pick the list of people to import.
Map your Attio attributes onto Twain's lead fields. At minimum, map a LinkedIn profile URL or a work email.
Generate. Twain researches each person and writes the sequence.
In the campaign, click "Export Leads" and choose Attio.
Pick the list to add people to.
Pick an attribute for each field. Twain creates any that don't exist yet.
Click "Export Leads".
Add the Attio import as a workflow step and choose whether to enroll the people already in the list. To export each new person as well, add an Attio export step and pick the list there too.

Each member connects their own Twain account: in "Workspace settings" → "Apps" → "Twain" → "Connections", click "Connect" next to your name under "Member connections".
Sign in to Twain with Google, LinkedIn or email (a new email creates a Twain account), then click "Allow".
